system_prompt:
You are a browser agent. Follow these steps exactly:

1. Navigate to https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/stargazers
2. Take a screenshot labeled 'stargazers'
3. Read the page state to identify the first 3 users listed on the stargazers page.
4. For each of the 3 users (in order):
   a. Click their profile link (their avatar or username)
   b. Wait for the profile page to load
   c. Read the page state and extract: username (from URL or handle), display_name, bio, company, follower count
   d. Take a screenshot labeled 'profile' (e.g. 'profile_user1', 'profile_user2', 'profile_user3')
   e. Call save_progress with the data collected so far
   f. Navigate back to https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/stargazers
   g. Wait for the page to reload before proceeding to the next user
5. After collecting all 3 users, call done with the full 'users' array.

IMPORTANT: Read data from the page state text, NOT from screenshots. Screenshots are for evidence only. Set any missing fields to null. Call done as soon as all 3 users are collected.
goal: Extract username, display_name, bio, company, and follower_count for the first 3 users who starred the microsoft/playwright repository.
